# wikiHow
> Trusted, collaboratively written how-to instructions covering everyday tasks, skills, relationships, health, technology, and more.

wikiHow publishes step-by-step guides, category hubs, quizzes, videos, and community resources designed to help people learn practical skills. Its content spans home, health, personal development, technology, education, and entertainment, with a strong emphasis on accessible instructions and broad topic coverage.

## Main Pages
- [Main Page](https://www.wikihow.com/Main-Page): wikiHow homepage with featured how-to articles, categories, and discovery links.
- [Guides](https://www.wikihow.com/Guides): Central hub for browsing wikiHow’s major instructional categories.
- [Trending](https://www.wikihow.com/Trending): Popular and currently trending articles, quizzes, and site content.
- [Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Quizzes): Main quizzes hub for personality, relationship, and trivia content.
- [About wikiHow](https://www.wikihow.com/wikiHow:About-wikiHow): Overview of wikiHow’s mission, editorial model, and platform background.
- [Community Dashboard](https://www.wikihow.com/Special:CommunityDashboard): Community activity hub for contributors, discussions, and site participation.

## Core How-To Categories
- [Arts and Entertainment](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Arts-and-Entertainment): How-to articles on hobbies, media, music, games, and creative interests.
- [Cars and Other Vehicles](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Cars-%26-Other-Vehicles): Guides for driving, maintenance, repairs, and vehicle ownership basics.
- [Computers and Electronics](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Computers-and-Electronics): Instructions for devices, software, internet tools, and troubleshooting.
- [Education and Communications](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Education-and-Communications): Articles on studying, writing, communication, and academic skills.
- [Family Life](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Family-Life): Advice and how-to content for parenting, caregiving, and family relationships.
- [Finance and Business](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Finance-and-Business): Practical guides for money management, jobs, and workplace topics.
- [Food and Entertaining](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Food-and-Entertaining): Cooking, baking, hosting, and food preparation instructions.
- [Health](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Health): Health-related how-to articles on wellness, symptoms, and self-care.
- [Hobbies and Crafts](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Hobbies-and-Crafts): Tutorials for crafts, collections, DIY projects, and leisure activities.
- [Holidays and Traditions](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Holidays-and-Traditions): Seasonal, cultural, and celebration-related how-to guides.

## More How-To Categories
- [Home and Garden](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Home-and-Garden): Home improvement, cleaning, gardening, and household maintenance articles.
- [Personal Care and Style](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Personal-Care-and-Style): Beauty, grooming, hygiene, and fashion-related instructions.
- [Pets and Animals](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Pets-and-Animals): Care guides for pets, wildlife, and animal behavior topics.
- [Philosophy and Religion](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Philosophy-and-Religion): Articles on beliefs, spirituality, and reflective practices.
- [Relationships](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Relationships): Advice and step-by-step help for dating, friendship, and social situations.
- [Sports and Fitness](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Sports-and-Fitness): Exercise, sports skills, training, and physical activity guides.
- [Travel](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Travel): Travel planning, packing, transportation, and destination-related help.
- [Work World](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Work-World): Career, office, job search, and professional development articles.
- [Youth](https://www.wikihow.com/Category:Youth): Guides tailored to teens, school life, and growing up.
- [Random Article](https://www.wikihow.com/Special:Randomizer): Random wikiHow article for broad content discovery.

## Quizzes and Interactive Content
- [Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Quizzes): Browse all quiz formats and popular interactive content.
- [Love Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Love-Quizzes): Relationship and romance quizzes focused on compatibility and feelings.
- [Personality Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Personality-Quizzes): Self-discovery quizzes about traits, habits, and preferences.
- [Trivia Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Trivia-Quizzes): General knowledge and pop culture trivia quiz collection.
- [Friendship Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Friendship-Quizzes): Quizzes about friendships, social dynamics, and interpersonal connections.
- [Entertainment Quizzes](https://www.wikihow.com/Entertainment-Quizzes): Interactive quizzes centered on celebrities, fandoms, and media.

- [Guides](https://www.wikihow.com/Guides): Browse instructional content by major subject area and category.

- [Category Tree](https://www.wikihow.com/Special:CategoryTree): Explore the full hierarchy of wikiHow categories and subtopics.
- [Random Article](https://www.wikihow.com/Special:Randomizer): Surface a random how-to article from anywhere on the site.
